commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "02a158935b48297da27845811bde440c24f7a58b"
printf '%s\n' '=== PlaceMap size/imports ==='
wc -l frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
sed -n '1,180p' frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
printf '%s\n' '=== PlaceMap middle ==='
sed -n '181,380p' frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
printf '%s\n' '=== PlaceMap tail ==='
sed -n '381,620p' frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx
printf '%s\n' '=== hook/state/effect counts ==='
for token in useState useMemo useEffect useCallback useQuery useMapEvents; do printf '%s ' "$token"; grep -o "$token" frontend/src/components/map/PlaceMap.tsx | wc -l; done
printf '%s\n' '=== related gallery implementation ==='
grep -RIn --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git 'useCenteredPlaceGallery\|closePlaceGallery\|togglePlaceGallery\|expandedPlaceId' frontend/src/components/map frontend/src/components | head -n 120 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== PlaceMap direct tests/usages ==='
grep -RIn --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git 'PlaceMap\|placesMotionSignature\|renderedMarkerPlaces\|galleryItemsByPlaceId' frontend/src frontend/e2e | head -n 180 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== map component files ==='
find frontend/src/components/map -maxdepth 1 -type f -print | sort
printf '%s\n' '=== working tree ==='
git status --short
